questions.question: Discuss some ways to develop creative thinking in daily life. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss some ways to develop creative thinking in daily life
  • • Keep an open mind and explore new ideas regularly.
  • • Engage in brainstorming or mind-mapping activities.
  • • Read widely from different subjects and cultures.
  • • Practice problem-solving from different perspectives.
  • • Maintain a journal to record new thoughts and inspirations.
  • • Spend time in creative hobbies such as drawing, music, or writing.
  • • Question assumptions and look for alternative approaches.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe the benefits of planning your tasks in advance. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the benefits of planning your tasks in advance
  • • Helps manage time effectively and reduces stress.
  • • Ensures better organization and prioritization of work.
  • • Improves productivity and efficiency.
  • • Avoids last-minute confusion or errors.
  • • Provides a sense of control and direction.
  • • Enables tracking of progress and timely completion of goals.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Identify ways to use language appropriately in different situations. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Identify ways to use language appropriately in different situations
  • • Choose formal language in professional or academic settings.
  • • Use polite and respectful expressions when speaking to elders or superiors.
  • • Adapt tone and vocabulary to suit the audience (e.g., friends vs. clients).
  • • Avoid slang or offensive terms in formal contexts.
  • • Use simple, clear, and concise language for effective communication.
  • • Listen carefully and respond appropriately to maintain context.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss the Don’t's in a group discussion. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the Don’ts in a group discussion
  • • Don’t interrupt or talk over others.
  • • Don’t dominate the discussion or ignore other viewpoints.
  • • Don’t get into personal arguments or show aggression.
  • • Don’t deviate from the topic.
  • • Don’t use disrespectful or offensive language.
  • • Don’t remain silent throughout — participation is key.
  • • Don’t neglect body language; stay attentive and engaged.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe the importance of body language in interview. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the importance of body language in an interview
  • • Reflects confidence, honesty, and enthusiasm.
  • • Creates a positive first impression on the interviewer.
  • • Supports verbal communication through gestures and expressions.
  • • Maintains professionalism through eye contact and posture.
  • • Helps convey interest and attentiveness.
  • • Reduces nervousness when used naturally and appropriately.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss on, how a cover letter complement a résumé during a job application. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss how a cover letter complements a résumé during a job application
  • • A cover letter introduces the candidate and highlights suitability for the job.
  • • It provides context to the résumé and personalizes the application.
  • • Explains how specific skills and experiences match the job requirements.
  • • Demonstrates communication skills and professionalism.
  • • Helps the employer understand the candidate’s motivation and interest.
  • • Strengthens the résumé by giving it a personal and persuasive touch.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss, why is the tone of a business letter important in professional communication. / [CO3] [4x5 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss why the tone of a business letter is important in professional communication
  • • Tone sets the overall impression of professionalism and respect.
  • • Helps maintain positive relationships with clients or colleagues.
  • • A polite and courteous tone encourages cooperation and goodwill.
  • • Prevents misunderstanding or conflict in written communication.
  • • Reflects the company’s values and credibility.
  • • The right tone ensures clarity, sincerity, and effective message delivery
  • (5 X 4 Marks=20)

questions.question: Discuss strategies to handle challenging situations and solve problems with examples. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss strategies to handle challenging situations and solve problems with examples
  • • Stay calm and composed: Avoid reacting impulsively; take a moment to think clearly before
  • responding.
  • Example: When facing customer complaints, listening patiently helps identify the real issue
  • instead of escalating tension.
  • • Identify the root cause:Analyze the situation carefully to understand the main problem.
  • Example: If team deadlines are missed repeatedly, finding out whether it’s due to workload or
  • miscommunication helps fix the issue.
  • • Generate possible solutions: Brainstorm different ways to overcome the challenge and
  • weigh their pros and cons.
  • Example: When facing low sales, trying new marketing techniques or improving product
  • presentation can help.
  • • Make a decision and act: Choose the most practical solution and implement it with
  • confidence.
  • • Seek feedback and learn: Review the outcome, note what worked or failed, and apply that
  • learning to future challenges.
  • • Maintain a positive attitude: Optimism builds resilience and motivates others during tough
  • times.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
